decisions.statement: A row is identified by a mark minted when the row is written.
A day has one open stretch at most.
The day a row began on is the ESO day the start of that row fell inside.
A row that began on another day is a fault of the day whose page holds it.
A day opens in the evening before that day.
A day's rows may have begun the day before.
A time naming no day of its own falls on the day `--day` names.
A time naming its own day keeps that day.
`--day` does not move a time naming its own day.
A caller naming no day leaves a bare time read against now.
A stretch is addressed by one of the four ways a caller names that stretch.
A safety no caller said is carried from the stretch before.
A level reading answers with the levels or with the reasons those levels were refused.
Every fault a day has is reported rather than the first alone.
An activity is read from the index rather than from the text of its page.

definition: the rows one of Alan's days is made of, read off the checkout and judged
